description: An `if` condition's `expr` wraps `state.input.missing` in 150 pairs of parentheses -- 150 levels of nesting, well past the explicit limit of 32 both engines enforce. Both engines reject the document at validation, before any effect runs, naming the location the way every other CEL check error does, then one line: 'expression is nested too deeply (limit 32)' -- never a recursion-limit dump of any kind, and never the whole expression quoted back.
